purpose: Human review navigation, not a runtime capability registry or an acceptance result. Read the implementations below for current methods, events and presentation capabilities.

implementation.presentation: src/notices.ts: Android-local banner and toast; shared React owns navigation/composer/avatar

note: No empty success stubs. File upload/download/save are real. Android sharePng uses a narrow private-cache FileProvider. Implementation presence does not establish merged-manifest, chooser/URI or device acceptance; consult the evidence for the specific build.

themePersistence.authority: Private silverhand-appearance-v1 SharedPreferences, theme key; five existing ThemeIds only
themePersistence.confirmation: IO-thread commit true before bridge resolve and visible publication; false/exception rejects and cached get cannot clear process-local unconfirmed marker
themePersistence.startup: Before mount; valid native theme wins; read failure/missing/invalid value uses unconfirmed mirror/default display and continues mount. No automatic migration or native overwrite.
themePersistence.compatibility: First explicit choice including the displayed theme must save; localStorage theme is only a compatibility mirror. Other appearance fields and iOS/desktop retain existing storage.
themePersistence.failure: Visible unconfirmed state; serialized saves continue after a rejected choice. No arbitrary-termination/power-loss zero-window promise.
